decisions.reason: This classic lever handle line sits close to the core range, cost little extra to add, and only launched in 2018, so there is no reason to withdraw it after one year.
As a multi-model handle family the firm has already invested in tooling and catalogue presence, and any early weakness can still be put down to the normal ramp-up through architects' specifications.
This single design is less entrenched than a full line, but it fits the established offer and is too new to judge, so the firm would keep it.
